diagnosis.what_happened: In regression coefficients tables (ضرایب رگرسیون) presenting models for multiple criterion variables, coefficient rows were stacked without a dedicated 'متغیر ملاک' column, forcing the reader to guess which set of constants and predictors belonged to which outcome.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Omitting the criterion variable column in coefficients tables caused structural ambiguity and reduced readability in consolidated multi-criterion reports.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: All regression coefficients tables (both linear regression coefficients and logistic regression variables in the equation) that present multiple dependent variables must include a dedicated Column 1 for 'متغیر ملاک' (e.g. 'رفتارهای خودآسیبی' and 'رفتارهای خودکشی') to cleanly group and identify the corresponding predictors.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Standard APA 7 Persian reporting requires unambiguous tabular hierarchy; every parameter must be explicitly attributed to its criterion variable.

desired_behavior: In all regression coefficients tables with multiple criteria, add 'متغیر ملاک' as Column 1, followed by 'متغیرهای مدل' / 'متغیرهای پیش‌بین' in Column 2, clearly demarcating the equations for each dependent outcome.
generalization: Whenever reporting consolidated regression coefficients across multiple dependent variables, always dedicate Column 1 to 'متغیر ملاک'.

evidence.observed_value: You should have this criterion variable column on the second table of regression too.
evidence.threshold_value: Dedicated 'متغیر ملاک' column in all regression coefficients tables
